description: URL literals that check-offline-bundle accepts. Every rule needs a reason. `files` is a glob over the scanned path (static/... or standalone/...); `**` matches any depth. Keep app-chunk rules narrow: a new host in static/ or standalone/.next/ is a real finding until proven otherwise.

rules.reason: XML, SVG and JSON Schema namespace URIs: identifiers, never fetched
React error decoder and docs links in error messages
Next.js docs and error-message links
Source, issue and license links in comments and error messages
Web standard specifications cited in comments
MDN and Node.js reference docs cited in comments
RFC 2606 reserved example domains in third-party docs and samples: never resolvable. Not allowed in app chunks, so the acceptance probe fetch("https://example.com") still fails

Next.js network features CCM keeps off at runtime: telemetry (NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1), the dev-only npm registry version check and config schema download. The runtime offline guard blocks them as well
Documentation and attribution links in comments and messages of traced third-party packages
